name: Entur Transit
description: Norway-wide transit stops, boards, routes, trip planning, alerts, vehicles, and stop facilities via Entur

entur-journey-planner.purpose: Fetch nearby stops, stop boards, line details, route sequences, trip planning, realtime journeys, and service alerts through Entur Journey Planner
entur-journey-planner.dataSent: Coordinates, stop IDs, line IDs, service-journey IDs, time windows, travel preferences, and the ET-Client-Name header
entur-journey-planner.dataReceived: GraphQL stops, lines, trip patterns, estimated calls, service situations, and encoded leg geometries

entur-vehicles.purpose: Track live positions of monitored Norwegian transit vehicles, either for a single line or within the map view, to show them on the map
entur-vehicles.dataSent: A GraphQL query containing either a line reference or bounding-box coordinates, a maximum data-age window, and the ET-Client-Name header; no user data
entur-vehicles.dataReceived: Realtime vehicle positions with coordinates, bearing, speed, delay, transport mode, occupancy, line, operator, and service-journey references

entur-nsr.purpose: Resolve detailed stop, quay, accessibility, facility, parking, and fare-zone metadata from Norway's National Stop Register
entur-nsr.dataSent: A REST request containing the stop place or quay identifier in the URL path and the ET-Client-Name header; no user data
entur-nsr.dataReceived: Stop place and quay records with coordinates, names, transport modes, platform codes, accessibility limitations, equipment, parking, and fare-zone details

entur-geocoder.purpose: Find public transport stops by name through Entur Geocoder v3
entur-geocoder.dataSent: Search text, result limit, stopPlace layer and NSR source filters, optional lowercase ISO2 country, multimodal mode, and ET-Client-Name header
entur-geocoder.dataReceived: Native GeoJSON features with structured names, coordinates, NSR IDs, stop types, transport modes, and supplier identity

entur-geocoder-nsr.purpose: Supply Entur National Stop Register geocoder data through Entur Geocoder v3
entur-geocoder-nsr.dataSent: No direct request to this dataset supplier; search text, result limit, country, layer, source and multimodal filters are sent to Entur's API
entur-geocoder-nsr.dataReceived: Native features supplied by Entur National Stop Register geocoder data, with names, coordinates, identifiers and available structured metadata
